notes: Abstract states only that the invention provides a method for preparing this compound; no steps, quantities or conditions are given in this section. Chinese 环磺酮 is tembotrione (not 磺草酮 / sulcotrione). The machine EN lines render it character-by-character as "cyclosulfonone", which names no real compound; the Chinese is followed and the EN string is kept as an alias for traceability. | Named in the prose as 环磺酮 (a triketone herbicide) and as the target of the DE19846792A1 process. The final product of step 11 of both drawn schemes is the same structure and is added as a SMILES alias per rule 4b. is_section_product is true because both routes in this section end at it. commercially_available is false because the section describes processes that prepare it. | The compound every process claim is directed to. Named in Chinese only, as 环磺酮, in the preambles of claims 1, 13 and 14; the EN lines render it tembotrione. Also drawn as the final product of the schemes at lines 612, 614, 618 and 620 (InChIKey IUQAXCIUEPFPSF-UHFFFAOYSA-N); that drawn SMILES is kept as an alias. One merged record. No quantity, yield or characterisation is printed in the claims. | 环磺酮 is tembotrione (not sulcotrione, 磺草酮). Section product of the one-pot route. The drawn product SMILES on line 535 matches the name and is kept as an alias. NMR is reported only as references to Figures 15 and 16; no peak list is printed, so h1 and c13 are null. | Section product. The Chinese 环磺酮 is tembotrione; an earlier machine translation of these lines rendered it as sulcotrione (磺草酮), a different herbicide, and the Chinese is authoritative. Structure taken from the step 3 product of the drawing on line 510. | The target of every route in this section and the compound the section ends on. Chinese 环磺酮; not 磺草酮 (sulcotrione), a different herbicide. | The compound the whole section is about: [0008] states the invention provides a new route and new intermediates for preparing it, and [0011], [0029] and [0030] repeat it as the target. Merged from those prose mentions and from the drawn schemes at lines 141, 143, 151 and 153, whose final product SMILES CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)C2C(=O)CCCC2=O)c(Cl)c1COCC(F)(F)F (read formula C17H16ClF3O6S) is tembotrione; that SMILES is carried as an alias per the drawing rule. The section states no quantity, yield or characterisation for it.

The prose names the starting material of the DE19846792A1 route only as 二氯甲苯 with no locants, so the name alone does not identify one isomer and resolved is false. The step-1 reactant drawn in the scheme immediately above it is Cc1c(Cl)cccc1Cl (2,6-dichlorotoluene); the SMILES is kept as an alias and the unlocanted prose name is kept verbatim rather than silently corrected.

Drawing-only: the step-1 reactant of the CN200510030163.5 scheme. The prose never names it. This is the single starting material by which the two prior-art routes in this section differ. | Carbon skeleton source, diazotised in situ. SMILES alias taken from the reactant of the scheme drawn before the step.

Written over the arrow of step 1 in both prior-art schemes. Kept as the formula printed in the drawing. | Sulfur nucleophile for the diazonium displacement. The printed 273 g is the mass of the 20% aqueous solution, not of CH3SNa. Also named in the drawn scheme conditions. The patent charges this as a 20% aqueous solution; the strength is recorded here and in the quantity note rather than as an alias, because a solution of a substance is not another name for it. | Drawing-only: a condition label on the scheme for the compound of formula (VI).

Drawing-only: over the arrow of step 1 of the CN200510030163.5 scheme, with CH3SNa and HCl, i.e. a diazotisation of the aniline. | Diazotising agent. The printed 251.41 g is the mass of the 20% aqueous solution, not of NaNO2; it is transcribed as printed. Also named in the drawn scheme conditions. The patent charges this as a 20% aqueous solution; the strength is recorded here and in the quantity note rather than as an alias, because a solution of a substance is not another name for it. | Appears only inside the drawn scheme for the preparation of the compound of formula (VI); the prose never names it.
Drawing-only: over the arrow of step 1 of the CN200510030163.5 scheme. | Drawing-only: a condition label on the scheme for the compound of formula (VI).
Drawing-only: product of step 1 and reactant of step 2 in both prior-art schemes. One record for both occurrences.

Over the arrow of step 2 in both prior-art schemes as CH3COCl, and named in the prose as 乙酰氯 in the Friedel-Crafts acylation the section criticises as 刺激性大 (highly irritating), which is why a hazard tag is emitted.

Over the arrow of step 2 of the DE19846792A1 scheme as AlCl3; the prose names it in Chinese as 催化剂三氯化铝 (the catalyst aluminium trichloride) in the waste water it produces, which fixes the role. The CN200510030163.5 scheme prints no catalyst over its step 2.

Over the arrow of step 3 in both prior-art schemes, oxidising the sulfide to the sulfone.

Drawing-only: product of step 4 and reactant of step 5 in both prior-art schemes.

Over the arrow of step 5 in both prior-art schemes, esterifying the benzoic acid. Recorded as reagent rather than solvent because the scheme uses it to form the methyl ester and the section says nothing about a reaction medium here.
Drawing-only: product of step 5 and reactant of step 6 in both prior-art schemes.

It appears solely as a drawn structure in the reaction scheme on line 535, where the vision read gives 'cyclohexane-1,3-dione (drawn as a structure)'. The SMILES alias is the 1,3-dione the locant in that read states. | Drawing-only: it appears in the schemes as a structure above or below the arrow and is labelled as such by the vision read. Drawing-only: the enol ester, product of step 10 and reactant of the final rearrangement step 11 in both prior-art schemes. Step 11 carries no reagent over its arrow.

The prose states that haloform is formed during the sodium hypochlorite reaction. 卤仿 is a class name and the section does not say which haloform, so resolved is false and the Chinese is kept verbatim. The later phrase 氯仿反应 in the same sentence names a reaction, not a reagent, and is not extracted as chloroform.
Named in the prose as the salt in the waste water produced by the sodium hypochlorite haloform reaction.

No quantity is given anywhere in the section. | HPLC mobile phase component, 20 parts by volume.
